From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Visibility rollcall: deals >$50k closing in next 30 days — 2wk action plan

Team —

Quick visibility check before the finance snapshot tomorrow afternoon. I pulled a focused extract (attached: pipeline_export_11052026.csv) for all open opportunities >$50k with a close date in the next 30 days. We have a handful where SF shows a close date but I can’t reconcile owner confidence — I need a short status update for each by EOD Friday (48h): Commit / At-Risk / No-Show + one-line reason and revised close week if needed.

If the deal is no longer progressing, please move to the correct stage (Closed Lost or Qualification) *and* add a one-line reason in the comments — we need accurate funnel flow for the Q4 forecast.

Priority list (please reply with the line items you own and your status):
- Lumina Health — $220k — expected close 2026-11-18 — owner: Ben
- NovaTech Platform — $95k — expected close 2026-11-22 — owner: Ben
- StellarHealth Integration — $180k — expected close 2026-11-26 — owner: Grace
- Parkview Systems — $60k — expected close 2026-11-20 — owner: Lauren

Two asks:
1) Update SF stage/close-date and add the short status tag above (Commit/At-Risk/No-Show).
2) If you mark At-Risk, add expected blocker and next milestone (e.g., legal review, PO, POC signoff) and estimate whether we can recover within 2 weeks.

I’ve attached the Lumina mutual action plan I last shared with them (Lumina_Mutual_Action_Plan_1105.pdf) — Ben, confirm whether the MAM is current.

Thanks — short replies appreciated, I’ll consolidate for finance.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
